## Problem

What friction, failure mode, or reuse gap does this change address?

## Change

What is the smallest coherent change?

## Evidence

- [ ] Repository validation passes
- [ ] Generated goal libraries are synchronized
- [ ] Agent Skills CLI discovers both skills
- [ ] Reusable ZIP packages build
- [ ] New or changed behavior has an example or verifier

## Compatibility

Does this affect skill invocation, Goal Contracts, execution profiles, standalone prompts, state paths, or archived results?

## Versioning

- [ ] `VERSION`, skill metadata, and `CHANGELOG.md` are aligned when behavior changes
- [ ] Migration notes are included when needed

## Safety

- [ ] No authority boundary was broadened unintentionally
- [ ] No secrets, private data, raw production dumps, or unnecessary logs are included
- [ ] Canonical files—not generated outputs—were edited
